name: Active Scout Tracking with NeRF
definition: A multi-target tracking method for pursuit-evasion games in highly occluded urban environments where a quadrotor scout tracks dynamic targets on the ground using Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) built online from RGB and depth images.
summary: Active Scout Tracking with NeRF is a multi-target tracking method that actively drives a scout's trajectory by maximizing mutual information between future and past observations using online NeRFs.
